quote.text: ما أصعب أن تتخلص النفس من الغضب بعد أن تُدفع إليه.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the challenge of tempering anger as a vital lesson for both you and your children, for a calm home nurtures thoughtful growth.
    • Teach by example: when anger arises, acknowledge it, reflect, and guide your family with measured reason rather than reactive outbursts.
  • Leadership
    • Recognize that once anger infiltrates the spirit, it clouds judgment; a true leader must work diligently to remain composed and clear-headed.
    • Inspire your team by addressing conflict with deliberate calm, transforming moments of anger into opportunities for constructive dialogue.
  • Product Management
    • Understand that impulses of anger, if unchecked, can derail even the best strategic initiatives—maintain calm to navigate setbacks effectively.
    • Foster a culture of reflection in your team where challenging moments become lessons in resilience, inspiring better product decisions over reactive changes.
